cameras.name: Name
cameras.area_hint: The heading the Security Cameras app lists it under. Cameras with the same heading are listed together; leave it empty for none.
cameras.access_anyone: Anyone the app is offered to
cameras.jobs_empty: No jobs listed: anyone sitting at a computer can watch it.
cameras.jobs_hint: Add a job (or gang) as your framework spells it, and the lowest grade allowed. Only they are offered the camera, and the server checks it.
cameras.fly_hint: Next you fly the camera to where it hangs. What you see is what it will show, and Enter keeps it.
cameras.search: Search by name, heading, id or job
cameras.none_placed: No camera put up from the panel yet.
cameras.watched_by_anyone: Anyone at a computer can watch it
cameras.delete_confirm: "%s" is taken down for good. Anyone watching it right now keeps its picture until they leave it.
cameras.remove_config_confirm: "%s" is no longer offered to anyone. It comes from the config, so it stays in this list and you can restore it at any time.
cameras.removed_hint: Removed in this panel: nobody is offered it until it is restored
cameras.full: No more than %s cameras can be put up from the panel
cameras.disabled: The Security Cameras app is switched off for the whole server (Enabled in configs/shared/cameras.lua), so nobody is offered any of these.

printers.place_hint: Next you stand it with the gizmo: on a desk, a counter or the floor.
printers.pick_title: Make an existing prop a printer
printers.pick_hint: Aim at a printer or copier the game already has in the world and press Enter. Nothing is spawned: the prop standing there becomes this printer.
printers.picked_hint: A prop the game already has in the world, so it cannot be swapped or moved. Delete this printer to give the prop back.
printers.name: Name
printers.name_hint: What the Print dialog calls it, so people know which one to walk to.
printers.no_props: No printer props are listed in configs/shared/printers.lua.
printers.empty: No printers yet. Place one near a computer and its apps can print to it.
printers.about: A computer prints to the printers within %s m of it. The pages wait in the tray until somebody takes them, as the %s item.
printers.disabled: Printing is switched off for the whole server (Enabled in configs/shared/printers.lua).
printers.full: There are as many printers as the panel can make (%s).
printers.delete_confirm_tray: "%s" is removed for good, and the %s pages waiting in its tray go with it.
printers.item_missing: Your inventory has no "%s" item yet, so nobody can take a page from a tray. Add it (README > Printers) and restart the inventory.

auto.title: Automatic computers
auto.master: Props in the world are computers
auto.master_hint: Switch this on and the monitors and laptops the game already has work as a computer wherever one stands, without being placed. While it is off, a computer is one you placed or picked.
auto.spare_hint: Not listed for this computer in configs/shared/computers.lua: tick it to add it
auto.computer_hint: Every prop ticked here is "%s" wherever the game has one.
auto.empty: No computer in configs/shared/computers.lua is a prop model.
auto.toast_on: Props in the world are computers
auto.toast_off: Props in the world are no longer computers

about.modern: A current desktop: centred taskbar, Start menu, rounded translucent windows.
about.retro: A 1991 shell inside a CRT monitor: grey bevelled windows, a DOS boot, period sounds.
about.mac: Top menu bar, a magnifying dock and windows with traffic-light buttons.

common.view_only_hint: You can look around, but changes need the edit permission.
